title: Change Order Sequence on a Ridgeline Installation Services Contract
content:
The number of change orders a Ridgeline Installation Services contract has already absorbed sets the change-sequence share of the change order administration fee.

**Clause.** Change-sequence share of the change order administration fee: the sequence is the number of change orders billed on the contract; exactly one takes the first-change share of 0.8, at least the third-change count of 3 takes the third-change multiple of 1.5, and any other number takes a change-sequence share of 1.

The change order administration fee is multiplied by the change-sequence share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the change order administration fee is rounded, the change order administration fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Change orders billed on the contract | Change-sequence share |
|---|---|
| 1 | 0.8 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 | 1.5 |
| 4 or more | 1.5 |

## Counting

Every change order billing line on the contract counts, including the change order the fee is being charged for. A change order reduction posts as a credit, not as a change order billing line, and is not counted; neither is a change order that lapsed unsigned.

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee of 50.00 before the share)

| Contract history | Count | Share | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| first change order just billed | 1 | 0.8 | 40.00 |
| second change order just billed | 2 | 1 | 50.00 |
| third change order just billed | 3 | 1.5 | 75.00 |
